messages.subject: Project Atlas - completion accounts query
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Quick one on Atlas (the Brampton Leisure acquisition) rather than anything current - our finance team are finalising the completion accounts and there's a £40k working-capital adjustment we want to check against the SPA mechanism before we sign off the retention release. Could someone confirm whether that falls inside or outside the agreed net-debt definition?

No great urgency, but would be good to close it out this month.

Thanks,
Nathan
Kingsford Group
